tables.name: delegation
tables.comment: One person covering another's row access for a period. Grants, never transfers: ownership stays where it is and the access lapses on its own.

tables.name: legal_hold
tables.comment: Stops erasure of an asset, or of everything about a person, until released (S2-03)

tables.name: message_template
tables.comment: Subject and body an administrator or the DPO set for one message junction and channel; absent means the code default

tables.name: project_processor
tables.comment: Who will collect for this project. Chosen at creation, before any site exists, because who collects is the first decision and the sites follow from it. Many-to-many: a study running at a partner campus and in-house at once is ordinary, not exceptional.

tables.name: rights_request
tables.comment: A data principal's request under ss.11-14 of the DPDP Act, and its clock. The clock starts on receipt, not on verification.

tables.name: rights_request_item
tables.comment: The erasure scope: one row per appearance of the principal in a collected asset. Disposition is applied to asset_consent, never to data_asset.

columns.name: full_name
columns.comment: Sealed by the key service on write; the portals decrypt. Length is bounded by the API, not the column

columns.name: dob
columns.comment: Date of birth, sealed by the key service; text because ciphertext is not a date. The s.9 test reads minor_until

columns.name: secondary_email
columns.comment: A second address the person added themselves; signs them in only once a code sent to it has come back

columns.name: secondary_email_verified_at
columns.comment: When a code sent to secondary_email came back; NULL means it never has

columns.name: minor_until
columns.comment: The date this person stops being a child under s.9: date of birth plus eighteen years. Kept in the clear so the test stays a comparison; dob itself is sealed

columns.name: ip_address
columns.comment: The address she consented from, sealed by the key service; text rather than inet because ciphertext is not an address

columns.name: token
columns.comment: Keyed digest of the token, and still the only thing lookups match on. A request presents a token, it is fingerprinted, and this column is compared - token_sealed is never used to authenticate, only to re-display.

columns.name: token_sealed
columns.comment: The link token, encrypted under a key derived from the application secret. Lets the URL be shown again to whoever needs to share it. NULL on links minted before 0011, whose tokens were never kept - those stay unrecoverable and the interface says so rather than showing a blank link.

columns.name: owner_user_id
columns.comment: The DCO or RCO accountable for this source. One answer, here, because the same rig serving three projects had its owner recorded three times when this lived on project_site - and nothing stopped those three disagreeing.

columns.name: site_id
columns.comment: The site this export covered, on the per-site exports that predate 0010. NULL on a project export, which covers every site the exporter could see - the rows themselves name their site.

columns.name: file_ref
columns.comment: Storage reference of the CSV exactly as generated; NULL for exports that predate 0023

columns.name: nominee_user_id
columns.comment: The account the nominee accepted with, set at acceptance; NULL for a nomination never accepted, or accepted before this column existed and matching no account

columns.name: note
columns.comment: A note from the author to whoever collects against this notice. Shown to the DCO and never to the data principal - it is an instruction to the collector, not part of the notice they are given.

columns.name: applicable_to
columns.comment: Who this notice addresses. Null on notices that predate the column; the publish checklist requires it, so nothing reaches a data principal without it being answered.

columns.name: data_categories_override
columns.comment: Rule 3(b)(i) for this notice only. NULL means the purpose's own list, which is the default and the common case. A value must be a subset of it - a notice may narrow what is collected, never widen it.

columns.name: uses_override
columns.comment: Rule 3(b)(ii) for this notice only. NULL means the purpose's own text.

columns.name: is_in_house
columns.comment: Whether this is the organisation collecting for itself. It drives routing: a project collected by a third party goes to a DCO Admin to be assigned, one collected in-house goes back to the R&D owner to assign an RCO. Separate from processor_type, which says what kind of thing a processor is (lab, tool) and not whose it is - a lab can be either.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Added while the project was in draft, or approved as an amendment: 'approved'. Requested against an already-approved project and not yet decided: 'pending'. Refused: 'rejected', with the reason kept.

columns.name: decision_reason
columns.comment: Why the DPO refused. Required on a rejection - "no" without a reason is a decision the R&D User cannot act on, so they ask again and get it again.

columns.name: source_id
columns.comment: The data source deployed at this site. Ownership is read through it: a site has no owner of its own.

columns.name: dco_override_user_id
columns.comment: Who runs this site on this project, when that is not whoever owns its data source. NULL - the usual case - means the source decides. Setting it changes nothing about the source or about other projects deploying the same source.

columns.name: dco_override_by
columns.comment: Who made the exception. An override with no author is an exception nobody can be asked about, which is the state the audit trail exists to prevent.

columns.name: due_at
columns.comment: Copied from the published response period at receipt. A period changed later does not move a request already running.

columns.name: executed_at
columns.comment: When every store holding the item was confirmed erased (S2-03). NULL until then, whatever the disposition says

constraints.name: consent_matches_role
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((subject_role = 'consented'::subject_role) AND (consent_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((subject_role <> 'consented'::subject_role) AND (consent_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: auth_user_email_indexed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((email IS NULL) OR (email_hash IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: auth_user_mobile_indexed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((mobile IS NULL) OR (mobile_hash IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: auth_user_organization_id_indexed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((organization_id IS NULL) OR (organization_id_hash IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: auth_user_secondary_email_differs
constraints.definition: CHECK (((secondary_email_hash IS NULL) OR (email_hash IS NULL) OR (secondary_email_hash <> email_hash)))

constraints.name: auth_user_secondary_email_indexed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((secondary_email IS NULL) OR (secondary_email_hash IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: auth_user_username_indexed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((username IS NULL) OR (username_hash IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: revocation_is_attributed
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_by IS NULL)) OR ((revoked_at IS NOT NULL) AND (revoked_by IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: nomination_email_indexed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((nominee_email IS NULL) OR (nominee_email_hash IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: nomination_mobile_indexed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((nominee_mobile IS NULL) OR (nominee_mobile_hash IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: nomination_some_contact
constraints.definition: CHECK (((nominee_mobile IS NOT NULL) OR (nominee_email IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: nomination_status_dates
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::nomination_status) AND (accepted_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'declined'::nomination_status) AND (declined_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'revoked'::nomination_status) AND (revoked_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (status = 'pending'::nomination_status)))

constraints.name: publishable
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'published'::notice_status) OR ((recipients_text IS NOT NULL) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: override_is_attributed
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((data_categories_override IS NULL) AND (uses_override IS NULL)) OR ((overridden_by IS NOT NULL) AND (overridden_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: processor_decision_is_attributed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = 'pending'::processor_request_status) OR (decided_at IS NULL) OR (decided_by IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: processor_rejection_has_a_reason
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'rejected'::processor_request_status) OR ((decided_by IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(length(TRIM(BOTH FROM decision_reason)), 0) > 0))))

constraints.name: site_override_is_attributed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((dco_override_user_id IS NULL) OR ((dco_override_by IS NOT NULL) AND (dco_override_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: s7_clause_required
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((lawful_basis = 'legitimate_use_s7'::lawful_basis) AND (s7_clause IS NOT NULL)) OR ((lawful_basis = 'consent_s6'::lawful_basis) AND (s7_clause IS NULL))))

constraints.name: item_execution_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['done'::character varying, 'waiting'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'held'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: rights_request_contact_indexed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((submitted_contact IS NULL) OR (submitted_contact_hash IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: rights_verified_is_attributed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((verification_status <> 'verified'::rights_verification_status) OR ((verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (verification_method IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: item_decided_is_attributed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((decision IS NULL) OR (decided_at IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: item_decision_has_basis
constraints.definition: CHECK (((decision IS NULL) OR (basis IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: item_retain_has_until
constraints.definition: CHECK (((decision IS DISTINCT FROM 'retain'::rights_scope_decision) OR (retain_until IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: ticket_message_kind
constraints.definition: CHECK (((kind)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['brief'::character varying, 'instruction'::character varying, 'message'::character varying, 'return'::character varying, 'escalation'::character varying, 'status'::character varying])::text[])))

views.name: v_current_consent
views.definition:
SELECT consent_id,
    consent_uuid,
    auth_user_id,
    notice_id,
    notice_language_id,
    notice_content_hash,
    link_id,
    served_at,
    affirmative_action_at,
    action_type,
    ip_address,
    is_withdrawal,
    supersedes_consent_id,
    created_at
   FROM consent_artefact ca
  WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM consent_artefact s
          WHERE (s.supersedes_consent_id = ca.consent_id))));
